title: Michael Bordenaro: Rent Payment Trouble Hits 20% in Bordenaro’s Housing Recap
description:
Original video author: Michael Bordenaro. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. Michael Bordenaro’s housing commentary highlights a cited survey finding that 20% of renters ages 18–64 reported late or incomplete rent payments in 2025. This recap covers the middle-income squeeze, rising mortgage payment trouble, and his cited calculation that incomes would need to rise 46% if home prices and rates stayed unchanged. We then explain his disagreement with Redfin’s affordability scenarios, concerns about everyday inflation, and prediction that rent cuts and landlord sales could pressure housing prices.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#MichaelBordenaro #MichaelBordenarohousingmarket #rentpaymentproblems #Weather #News

Warm natural afternoon light, calm and approachable delivery, medium shot, subtle camera movement. This is an independent presenter, not Michael Bordenaro; do not imitate his likeness.
